title: Zone 1 thermostat flips home/away every few minutes
pre_fix_commit: 88a6ced46 (parent of 852e57379, which recorded the zone 1 feed-split finding)
task: Event run. climate.thermostat_bryant_wifi_studyb_zone_1 has flipped between home and away about 46 times since 08:54. Find out who is writing what and whether the thermostat is really changing. Act within tiers and submit a report.
context_pack: Zone 1 is a Bryant/Carrier Infinity zone via ha_carrier (cloud + websocket). ha_carrier exposes preset_mode (from the STATUS feed) and hold_activity (from the CONFIG feed).
URA's S1 site writes the zone's target preset each 5-min tick when the zone does not read its target.

response.preset_mode: alternates: 'away' for ~5-8 min after each URA write, then 'home' (setpoints 70-76)

response.rows_summary: only URA S1 preset_change 'away' writes on zone_1 (reason vacant_past_grace / house away), one on roughly every second tick; no other writer

fixtures.source: §9.9: decision_log shows only URA away writes; ~57 writes/day

changes.what: ha_carrier config entry reloaded by the operator

response.after_reload: 13:20:03 preset_mode=home 70-76, hold_activity=away; away 13:23, home 13:29, away 13:32, home 13:39

response.text: preset_mode = the STATUS feed's current activity; the status feed's setpoints go stale and are refreshed only by the periodic full poll. hold_activity = the CONFIG feed, updated promptly on writes. Everything else - lockout, arrester, S1 - trusts preset_mode, which is the lagging field.
